item.title: Woman who used partner’s £286,000 injury settlement to gamble faces the courts

item.title: Nottingham enforcement teams issue 767 PCNs to motorists over Blue Badge abuse
item.description: Use of fake Blue Badges for parking trebled in Nottingham in 2025 – with total court fines doubling to more than £33,000.
